title: FLESH & ASH
description: Uncover the horror of the Flesh and Ash. Face an evolving army of bloody zombies and strange grey leaders!
body:
🩸 Flesh & Ash (Survival Horror Mod) Flesh & Ash is a survival horror content mod that increases the difficulty of Minecraft by adding new dangerous enemies and a powerful boss to the world.

❓ Why download this mod? This mod is designed for players who want to transform the familiar world of Minecraft into a dangerous horror environment. It adds an atmosphere of dread, making nighttime walks and cave exploration challenging, forcing the player to constantly be on guard to survive.

💥 What exactly does the mod add? New hostile creatures (mobs) The mod updates the list of in-game threats, introducing new enemy categories: Zombie Butcher and Krog: A group of grotesque, fast, and aggressive monsters composed of raw meat. They roam the darkness, attack in packs, and hunt the player. Ripper: A special, dangerous gray monster with a large pool of health and high damage, posing a serious threat upon encounter. Butcher: A large and extremely powerful mutated creature with a huge pool of health. It serves as the final test of the player's combat equipment.
